Phil Barker. Tetherd is a Docker helper that keeps containers attached to the network of the container they route through — typically apps sharing a VPN sidecar such as gluetun.
It is a clean-room successor to Rebuild-DNDC: same job, no shared code, MIT licensed. Support is via GitHub issues until an Unraid forum thread exists; update this file with that thread URL when it does.
